Meet Your Nail Artist

Hi, I'm Xia

I'm a nail artist based in Calgary's Applewood area — specializing in GELX, 3D nail art, and custom sets that are as unique as you are. With 570+ posts of real client work, you know exactly what you're getting.

Whether you want something soft and romantic or bold and editorial — I'm here to bring your nail vision to life. DM me on Instagram to chat inspo and book your spot.

Transparent pricing

How pricing works

Choose your base length first, then select any nail art add-ons that match your inspo. Final price is confirmed before the appointment.

  • Remaining balance paid in cash

Contact

Questions?

If you have any questions about services, pricing, availability, or your appointment, feel free to reach out. I'll get back to you as soon as possible.

Message on Instagram Book Your Appointment

Book directly through the website by choosing your service, date, and time. After submitting, you’ll receive deposit instructions by email. Your appointment is fully confirmed once your $15 deposit is received.

GELX is a builder gel system that creates lightweight, flexible extensions with a natural finish. It's gentler on your natural nails than acrylic while still giving you the length and durability you want.

I'm based in Calgary's Applewood area (YYC). Exact address is shared after booking confirmation.

A solid colour set takes about 2 hours. Sets with detailed nail art or 3D elements can take 2+ hours depending on complexity. I'll give you a time estimate when you book.

Absolutely — the more inspo photos the better! Add your inspo notes when booking or send them through Instagram so I can plan the design and confirm any add-ons.

Discounts cannot be stacked with each other or with other promos. Only one discount applies per appointment. Birthday discount requires valid ID.

Yes! Birthdays, grad events, and matching bestie sets are always welcome. DM me to chat availability and the matching sets discount applies automatically.
